decisions.why: Wrist braces (small/medium, left/right) are upper limb orthotics and supports
Three-wheeled walker and ultra-narrow lightweight walking frame are walking aids; wheelchair ponchos/macs are accessories, not wheelchair units themselves
Washington tilt-in-space cradle and width-adjustable bath board with handle are bathing and toileting aids
Transaqua shower commode chairs are bathing and toileting aids
Long shoehorn, zipper pulls, threading helper, and sock-stocking aid are daily living aids
Q50R Carbon and steel compact transport wheelchairs are wheelchairs and specialist seating
Jar/bottle opener, tube squeezer, anti-slip coasters, straw clips are daily living and eating aids
Black perching stool, Winsham heavy duty high-back chair, and Torbay heavy duty perching stool are examination couches and clinical furniture
Utensil strap, two-handled ceramic mug, cup caps, and sure-grip mug are daily living aids for eating
Ultra-narrow lightweight walking frame is a walking aid; wheelchair brakes/parts are spare components
Ultra-narrow lightweight walking frames are walking aids; replacement tray and net bag are accessories
Writing grip and playing card holder are daily living aids; pedal exerciser with digital display is therapy and exercise equipment
Tenura silicone anti-slip mats and coasters are daily living aids
Tri-fold and lightweight suitcase ramps are access and mobility ramps
Surrey height adjustable commode chair, senator plastic raised toilet seats, and Norfolk height adjustable chemical commode chair are bathing/toileting aids
Solo Skandia heavy duty raised toilet seats are bathing aids; heavy duty lightweight walking frame and double adjustable crutch are walking aids
Telescopic channel ramps are access and mobility ramps
Malling perching stools in various sizes are specialist seating
Tenura non-slip reels and non-slip fabric are daily living aids
